scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.reasoning: The agent did an excellent job diagnosing the root cause, identifying the configuration mismatch, and explaining the causal chain. The analysis was thorough and even included actionable fix suggestions. The main weakness is that the full list of solution projects wasn't explicitly enumerated in the output — it was summarized as '42 projects' without listing them. The agent also hit some file-not-found errors when trying to read large tool outputs but recovered well by using alternative approaches. Overall a strong analysis with one gap in completeness.
